results.description: Bootleg Vol. III (2021) from Heaven’s Door features a cask strength 13-year Kentucky Bourbon finished in Spanish wine barrels. Named after Bob Dylan’s “Bootleg Series” of albums, this annual limited release blends art and craft with rare expressions presented in a handmade leather case and ceramic bottle featuring Dylan’s original paintings.
